test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 15 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Consider 4th march to be a Wednesday in 2018. What day of the week will it be on 7th March in 2019?
solution:
Given: **4th March 2018** was Wednesday.

Now,

2018 to 2019 = 1 Year (1 Ordinary Year).

And, In 1 Year = 1 Ordinary Year.

So, 1 Ordinary Year has 1 odd day.

then, 4th March 2019 will be Wednesday + 1 = Thursday.

Now, the number of days between 4th March 2019 to 7th March 2019

= 3 days.

So, **7th March 2019** will be Thursday + 3 = Sunday.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
